verdict: Organic visibility is the only active channel; GBP momentum is mixed.
narrative: Across all three entities this period, organic Google Business Profile activity was the sole source of inbound engagement — no paid spend ran on any channel. Combined, your listings generated 395 GBP actions over the last 28 days, with O'Hare Precision Metals leading and showing a 25% week-over-week uptick, while Forte and Advance Grinding both saw GBP actions fall roughly 42% in the most recent 7 days, confirmed by two to three consecutive zero-action days. Search click volume is also trending down across all entities, pointing to a broader organic visibility softening rather than a single-listing issue. Several CRM, outreach, and SEO workstreams that were due in August and September are being advanced now, with the target to have stub reconciliation, contact outreach sequences, and site reindexing resolved by end of October. Once those are live, you'll have active outreach and improved search presence working alongside the GBP channel.

watch_item.issue: Two of your three GBP presences hit consecutive zero-action days this past week, and search clicks are declining across all entities — a signal that organic visibility is softening.
watch_item.fix: Site reindexing and the SEO root-cause fix are targeted for completion by October 31, and contact outreach sequences are being activated this month to put a second channel alongside organic search.
